cases.scenario: Post a nonempty ASCII comment to the exact granted issue.
Preserve BMP text and a supplementary scalar in UTF-8.
Hash precomposed text without normalization.
Canonically equivalent decomposed text has different bytes and hash.
A nonempty whitespace-only body is preserved, including CRLF and tab.
An escaped NUL is a valid scalar and remains part of the body digest.
A path-safe but ungranted repository is mapped literally and denied.
Changing the owner does not inherit the original repository grant.
A valid issue number outside the exact grant is denied.
An exact replacement grant permits the changed issue.
Repository and issue values from different grants cannot be recombined.
Pairwise matches do not replace one exact repository/issue/data-class tuple.
One fully coupled grant is sufficient even when decoy grants are present.
An empty, well-formed grant list provides no authorization.
Revocation denies a call that otherwise matches every grant condition.
Known revocation takes precedence over unaccepted partial scope.
The narrowed byte bound is inclusive: cafe with an accent occupies five bytes.
Four UTF-16 code units are five UTF-8 bytes and exceed a four-byte policy bound.
The separate context principal must match the trusted policy principal.
Otherwise authorized partial direct scope requires review when explicitly not accepted.
A known absent grant denies rather than being softened to partial-scope review.
A known body-byte violation denies before partial-scope review.
A different MCP tool name is unsupported, not silently translated into a comment.
An extra executable argument is invalid and must not be ignored.
The outer envelope also rejects extra keys.
MCP call keys are exactly name and arguments; extra confirmation parameters are invalid.
Null encodes absent context evidence; authorization is not evaluated.
Evidence bound to a different implementation identifier is not trusted.
An empty string is outside the native body domain.
A structured body is not coerced into a comment string.
A missing issue is invalid native input, not a wildcard or reviewable authorization target.
Null cannot identify an issue.
Numeric strings are not coerced to issue numbers.
Owner case is preserved and compared exactly even if the provider might resolve it equivalently.
Repository case is preserved and does not match the differently cased grant.
An empty owner is not a GitHub path identifier.
An empty repository is not a GitHub path identifier.
A path separator cannot change the fixed endpoint structure.
A traversal dot segment is not a path-safe repository identifier.
Encoded separators are not decoded or accepted as identifiers.
Unicode body text is allowed but Unicode owner identifiers are not.
Repository identifiers are not trimmed into a valid value.
The inclusive 2147483647 issue limit maps exactly and can receive an exact grant.
Issue numbers must be positive.
Negative issue numbers are invalid.
Fractional issue numbers are not rounded.
A safe integer above the explicit issue cap is still invalid.
An unsafe JavaScript integer is not an issue identifier.
A scalar-valid mixed body at exactly 8192 UTF-8 bytes is accepted.
A body below 8192 UTF-16 code units but above 8192 UTF-8 bytes is invalid before policy.
An unpaired high surrogate must not be replaced before hashing.
An unpaired low surrogate is not a Unicode scalar string.
A missing native lane cannot be inferred from a fixture's lane label.
The native call must be an object.
An unknown outer lane is invalid rather than routed to a supported lane.
